comment: B’s shallower residual network beat the deeper residual alternatives despite having fewer LayerNorms; smooth GELU D beat equally normalized plain ReLU C despite D’s unnormalized tail. The likely mechanisms are easier optimization and activation-dependent XOR learning, but this ranking alone cannot isolate them. I overextended K1018’s low-displacement LN preference and K1061’s final-normalization evidence; K1018 explicitly leaves Adagrad extrapolation unvalidated. Backtests reject a general shallow-residual override: 0/4 history pairs and 0/4 approximately rate-matched lab pairs favored it. Smooth plain nets won 3/3 equal-depth/equal-LN Adagrad history pairs, but exact-rate lab coverage was absent. These checks do not justify a general rule predicting the complete gold order.
